theme: 孤獨死＋遺體多日未被發現
example_source: 《北市77歲來姓榮民「孤獨死」！遺體腐爛流屍水 月餘無人發現》，Yahoo奇摩新聞（轉載地方新聞）

theme: 孤獨死通報量攀升、逾4成死亡逾3天才被發現（議員質詢揭露的制度性統計）
example_source: 台北市議員洪健益質詢揭露：北市列管獨居長者逾萬人，今年「孤獨死」案例達70多人（其中5人在公宅內死亡），逾4成孤獨死是在死亡3天後才被發現——此統計被多家媒體（含PChome/NOWnews轉載之《嬤孤獨死2個月！名醫揭1現象：台灣不及格》等）引用討論，但搜尋工具未能鎖定單一原始報導網址，故未附連結

theme: 里長因個資法限制難尋家屬，須獨自處理孤獨死後事
example_source: 《孤獨死「受限個資法」找嘸家屬...里長伴屍5小時 黃偉哲回應了》，Yahoo奇摩新聞（台南地方新聞）

theme: 居家跌倒後無人即時察覺，錯失黃金救援時間
example_source: 《獨居老人告白：「最怕在家跌倒無人發現」弘道暖助建安全網》，弘道老人福利基金會官方新聞稿

theme: 獨居長者外出時於偏僻處發生意外，因無人在場而錯失搶救時機
example_source: 《快訊／疑撿水果！高雄89歲翁推輪椅出門「失足墜溝」 偏僻無人救溺斃》，三立新聞網SETN

theme: 居家用火／瓦斯／電線老舊釀成火警，行動不便的獨居長者逃生不及
example_source: 《高雄永安透天厝冒濃煙！64歲獨居婦倒地燒燙傷 送醫不治》，壹蘋新聞網（2026年9月）；另有《長者租屋獨居！高雄三合院竄火伴爆炸 77歲婦燒成焦屍》，TVBS新聞網

theme: 詐騙集團鎖定獨居長者情感孤寂、渴望關愛的弱點行騙（假投資／假交友／假檢警）
example_source: 《獨家影音／超高齡社會來臨！詐團攻破孤獨防線 長者被騙不敢說》，TVBS新聞網

theme: 詐騙／偽造文件侵占獨居老人鉅額財產或遺產的重大刑案
example_source: 《詐欺集團偽造遺囑詐取獨居老人遺產1.4億，北檢起訴律師、警察和書記官等44人》，The News Lens關鍵評論網

theme: 長者遭詐騙後因羞於啟齒而隱瞞家人，甚至萌生輕生念頭
example_source: 《詐獵老人1／脆弱心靈誰關懷？長者遭詐騙年破9千人 20多人欲走絕路》，TVBS新聞網

theme: 認知或體力衰退的長者獨自外出走失，需靠監視器或在地居民協助多日尋回
example_source: 《8旬翁深夜走失 草莓園老闆憑記憶帶警荒地尋回》，自由時報電子報；另有《龜山7旬翁失蹤4天找到了！派出所接力調監視器尋蹤跡》，聯合新聞網

theme: 夏季高溫下獨居長者中暑／熱衰竭的疑慮（不捨開冷氣、室內悶熱無人察覺）
example_source: 此擔憂在台灣新聞中以「熱傷害就醫人次創新高」的統計報導形式存在（如衛福部統計、TVBS《六月已48人熱傷害》），但查無台灣本地『獨居老人中暑死亡』的具體單篇個案報導；反而是台灣媒體轉載的日本案例《日本72歲老翁為省錢不開冷氣中暑亡》常被引用來討論同類擔憂——誠實標註：Taiwan本地具體個案未鎖定，冬季失溫的獨居個案同樣未查得具體台灣單篇報導

theme: 延伸調查關鍵字建議（供後續研究參考，非單一報導）
example_source: 可再延伸搜尋：老老照顧／長照悲歌／長照殺人；獨居長者憂鬱症與自殺意念；獨居老人「斷炊斷藥」或水電費未繳作為安危警訊；個資法阻礙里長／鄰里通報機制；社會孤立與失智共病；詐騙受害者沉默文化（不敢告知子女）；緊急救援按鈕／到宅關懷送餐服務涵蓋率；極端氣候（熱浪／寒流）專案關懷通報機制；獨居老人服藥錯誤／用藥安全事件

theme: 長輩拒絕/忘記吃藥，子女誤以為是「不配合」，後來才發現是真的做不到（認知/動作能力衰退）
example_source: Dcard 閒聊版貼文「我以為我爸不吃藥是不配合，後來才發現他是真的做不到」

theme: 擔心遠方/獨居長輩發生跌倒等意外，求助科技方案（跌倒偵測、穿戴裝置）能否即時通報
example_source: PTT iOS 板討論「跌倒偵測需要在有網路的情況下才有用嗎」，原因是擔心獨居長輩跌倒後家人不知情

theme: 擔心獨居長輩「孤獨死」——不是怕死亡本身，是怕過世多日無人發現
example_source: PTT WomenTalk 討論串「大家會擔心孤獨死嗎？」（由藝人猝死多日才被發現事件引發的熱議，留言分歧：多數人認為重點是有人定期關心而非有無子女）

theme: 長輩固執抗拒長照資源／不願意讓外人（居服員、日照中心）介入，家屬蠟燭兩頭燒、心力交瘁
example_source: PTT elderly 板「照顧自家人的辛苦」；PTT WomenTalk「擺爛不長照會怎樣嗎」「照顧長輩會有厭世感要怎麼解？」

theme: 子女與獨居父母養成固定/高頻率電話報平安的習慣，作為「還活著、還好」的替代確認機制
example_source: Dcard 心情版貼文「跟家人每天三通電話」

theme: 家長難溝通、固執己見、不聽勸，讓子女感到疲憊、無解，甚至產生「厭世感」
example_source: PTT WomenTalk「家裡老人很難溝通怎麼辦？」「到底該怎麼應對長輩的不友善」

theme: 為獨居/半獨居長輩加裝居家攝影機以便遠端查看安全狀況（Mobile01 常見選購討論類目，部分討論明確提及是為了長輩獨居安全需求）
example_source: Mobile01「請推薦家用的智慧攝影機」等居家監視器討論串

theme: 長輩身體不適或心情低落卻「報喜不報憂」、不主動說，家人常常是後來才發現——此主題在論壇上多以個人心情/心理板貼文出現，但更系統性的描述集中在衛教與新聞媒體（董氏基金會、康健雜誌等），未查到能直接引用的特定論壇討論串標題
example_source: 衛教文章與心理健康機構描述的普遍現象（非特定論壇討論串），推論其在 PTT WomenTalk / Dcard 心情板應有零星個人分享，但本次搜尋未鎖定到具體可引用的串

theme: 擔心長輩接到詐騙電話上當受騙（金錢、個資），是普遍且被高度關注的社會焦慮，但本次搜尋未能鎖定 PTT/Dcard 上專門討論「長輩被詐騙電話」的具體討論串（多為一般詐騙心得或新聞報導，非鎖定長輩情境）
example_source: 未查得可引用之特定論壇討論串；此為根據搜尋結果誠實回報的缺口，建議日後可用更精準關鍵字（如「爸媽 詐騙 電話 匯款」「長輩 假冒公務員 電話」）再搜一次

theme: 建議延伸調查關鍵字（非既有討論主題，為本次搜尋後歸納的下一步方向）：「獨居 長輩 不敢麻煩子女」「長輩 假裝身體很好」「長輩 走失 失智 GPS」「長輩 一個人吃飯 隨便吃」「顧老人 情緒勒索」「遠距離孝親 焦慮」「長輩 手機不會用 求救」「安心手環 緊急按鈕」
example_source: 根據本次搜尋觀察到的相鄰主題與資訊缺口所做的關鍵字延伸建議，非既有討論串

theme: Fear of falling or becoming incapacitated at home with no one noticing for days — the single most-repeated safety worry from people actually living alone
example_source: AARP Online Community, Caregiving forum, thread 'Safety - I live alone with no reliable support system': poster (59, disabled, no local family) writes 'I could lie dead or unable to summon help for many days before anyone noticed'; replies suggest Meals on Wheels and daily automated check-in calls as the practical fix

theme: 'Dying alone and undiscovered' as a rising, named fear among aging Americans without a spouse or children — English-language press is explicitly importing Japan's 'kodokushi' (lonely death) framing for a US/UK audience
example_source: KFF Health News feature 'An Age-Old Fear Grows More Common: I'm Going To Die Alone' (notes 15M+ Americans 55+ have no spouse/children, ~2M have no family at all); background concept documented at Wikipedia 'Kodokushi'; classic clinical case series in NEJM 'Persons Found in Their Homes Helpless or Dead'

theme: Self-neglect (poor hygiene, malnutrition, unsafe/unsanitary home) as a hidden, gradual risk in solo-living elders — escalating in the extreme to Diogenes syndrome (compulsive hoarding + squalor + refusal of help + no shame about it)
example_source: PMC review 'Diogenes Syndrome: Identification and Distinction from Hoarding Disorder'; Psychology Today 'Senile Squalor and Hoarding'; Frontiers in Medicine 2021 review on elder self-neglect (Korean cohort: 22.8% self-neglect prevalence among those living alone); note ~50% mortality within 5 years of onset

theme: Social isolation/loneliness treated by researchers as a quantified mortality and dementia risk factor on par with smoking or obesity — this is the most-cited hard science behind the forum-level fear
example_source: Holt-Lunstad et al. meta-analyses (PLOS Medicine 2010; Perspectives on Psychological Science 2015, ~3.4M people, loneliness +26% mortality risk); NIA news release 'Social isolation, loneliness in older people pose health risks'; Johns Hopkins Medicine 2023 release linking isolation to dementia risk

theme: Elder phone/financial scams explicitly exploiting loneliness and living-alone status (grandparent scam, IRS/government impersonation, romance scams) — repeatedly framed in news coverage as preying on isolation, not just age
example_source: FBI 'Scammers Target Older Adult Victims'; NCOA 'Top 5 Financial Scams Targeting Older Adults'; FDIC 2025 consumer alert; average reported loss per older victim >$38,000 in 2025

theme: Medication non-adherence (forgetting doses, confusing regimens) as a leading driver of preventable hospitalizations/nursing-home admissions for elders managing meds without supervision
example_source: Academic literature summarized via PMC: up to 10% of hospital admissions and up to 25% of nursing-home admissions linked to medication non-compliance in older adults, worsened by cognitive decline and vision problems

theme: Falls at home going unnoticed/untreated for hours because no one else is present — living alone independently raises both fall incidence and delay-to-help
example_source: Elsevier/Enfermería Clínica (English ed.) study on falls in older persons living alone; same AARP thread above cites fall risk as the top reason the poster fears living alone

theme: Elder refusing offered help/care and insisting on independence ('when I need help, I'll know') — a constant friction point in caregiver-support forums, distinct from cold-open topic selection but relevant to why check-ins get rebuffed
example_source: HealthUnlocked caregiver forum threads (e.g. 'Advice for elderly mother with cirrhosis who is not taking care of herself'); AOL/lifestyle piece '10 Useful Tips For Dealing With Irrational Elderly Parents Who Refuse Help'

theme: 'Elder orphans' / 'solo agers' — a named, actively-researched population (no spouse, no children, no local support) with measurably higher fear of dying alone, forced relocation, and being 'unbefriended' (no one to act as health proxy) — strong keyword to dig into further
example_source: Carney et al., 'Elder Orphans Hiding in Plain Sight: A Growing Vulnerable Population' (PMC); AARP 2021 survey on solo agers (12% of US 50+ population; solo agers fear dying alone at 46% vs 37% for others); PMC piece on 'unbefriended' advance-directive risk
